predictions.articleTitle: Banfield vs Boca Juniors Tactical Breakdown & Preview: Can Troglio's Low Block Stall Boca's Five-Match Surge?

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Boca's 60% possession control tests Banfield's resilient low block in Mendoza.

spf.comment: Retains both a controlled 0:1 Boca Juniors victory and a 1:1 regulation draw, as knockout shootout incentives and Boca's narrow-margin scoring profile make a single call unnecessarily exposed.

score.comment: 0:1 reflects Boca's run of three consecutive 1:0 wins over Banfield's leaky backline, while 1:1 captures Banfield's primary transition or dead-ball equalizer route.

goals.comment: Aligns directly with the top two exact-goal Poisson densities (26.7% for 2 goals, 23.7% for 1 goal) in a cautious semi-final.

bqc.comment: Banfield's compact first-half block points to a level break before Boca's superior depth either decides it late (Draw-Loss) or settles into a 90-minute draw (Draw-Draw).
